Patek Philippe Ref. 2499 First Series sells for US$10.26M at Phillips Hong Kong (30–31 May 2026)

Lot 941, a 1951 Ref. 2499 in 18K pink gold, sold for HK$80,370,000 (US$10,255,212) against an estimate of HK$24–48 million.

The sale totalled HK$403.8 million (US$51.52 million), with 293 of 294 lots sold. Phillips calls the lot the highest-value timepiece ever sold in Asia.

Phillips' release does not say whether buyer's fees are included in these figures.

Would you bid on a Ref. 2499 at this price, or would you rather keep the money for a modern piece?
